attention_protocol: original V4 prefix-cache final-query eager rows

definition.layerwise_half_boundary: first of three consecutive layers whose discovery needle-minus-ordinary expected-error-reduction specificity is at most half the median over the first quarter of layers
definition.layerwise_near_zero_boundary: first of three consecutive layers whose discovery specificity has absolute magnitude at most 0.10 count
definition.specificity: needle restoration effect minus ordinary restoration effect
definition.strict_absolute_error_reduction: |strict corrupt prediction - gold| minus |strict restored prediction - gold|; invalid prediction has error 10
